patch.value: Classify abandoned build leases as infrastructure refusals in linked-test evidence

An abandoned run-tests build lease refuses before Vitest executes, but pm test currently records assertion_failure. Preserve the conservative owner/consumer policy and original refusal while reporting infrastructure failure with explicit no-test-execution provenance. This extends the completed early lease diagnostic and narrow lock-contention classification; it does not authorize automatic lease deletion.

A real abandoned build-lease fixture refuses before executing a test; SDK CLI and MCP evidence classify it as infrastructure rather than assertion failure; Unrelated assertion failures and ambiguous or live owners retain their existing behavior; Recovery preserves lease evidence and never steals by age.
